meta.name: Humko Deewana Kar Gaye
meta.description: Aditya, an engineer, travels to Canada for training. There he meets Jia, a beautiful woman from an influential family. Fate keeps pushing the pair together, and even though both are already betrothed to others, Adi and Jia fall in love.
meta.slogan: One life... one moment... one coincidence... changed their lives forever.
